# kdbinsidebrains (data only)

`lib/help-builtins.tsv` seeds its one-liners, signatures and doc paths from the
word CSVs of the KdbInsideBrains IntelliJ plugin
(https://github.com/kdbinsidebrains/plugin), used under the Apache License 2.0
(see LICENSE in this directory). No code is vendored — only that dictionary
data, merged 2026-08-14 and hand-curated in the TSV from then on. The
remainder of the TSV (syntax forms, examples) comes from TimeStored qstudio's
built-in docs, contributed by their owner.
